claims.claim: More than 80 built-in check types are registered
Check types include contains, max_length, llm_judge, regex, banned_words
Assertion config in scenario YAML assertions:, runs after generation in testing
Guardrail config in pack validators:, runs during LLM generation
Eval config in pack evals:, scores 0.0-1.0
All three share the EvalTypeHandler registry
Eval handlers produce scores only and never determine pass/fail
AssertionEvalHandler applies min_score/max_score; without thresholds a score of 1.0 passes
GuardrailEvalHandler checks whether the score indicates a violation and enforces policy (truncate, replace, block)
Mermaid diagram edges (check types -> registry -> assertion/guardrail/eval -> reports/records/metrics)
Assertions run only in Arena; when: for conditional checks; pass_threshold for statistical testing
Guardrails run during every LLM call; streaming-capable checks can abort early
fail_on_violation is deprecated as of PromptPack v1.7.0 (RFC 0015) and ignored; stays schema-valid until v2.0.0; a triggered validator rewrites or blocks whatever its value
enabled: false switches a validator off
Guardrails run before the call, after it, or both via direction
Evals run on configurable triggers; results exported as Prometheus metrics and trace events
A triggered guardrail does not return an error; the round loop stops either way; only provider work in the turn's ProviderStage is affected, downstream stages still run
content_excludes and banned_words replace the whole response with a policy message
max_length or any check with max_characters/max/max_chars truncates to that limit when the response exceeded it
Every other case replaces the response with the policy message; no log-only mode

Input guardrails run before the provider call, spend no tokens, return a canned assistant turn whose text is the validator message, else the check replacement, else the default blocked message; evaluated once per user turn
On enforcement the round loop stops; tool calls requested by an enforced output response are dropped
All violations recorded in message.Validations and emitted as validation.failed events
Go handlers implement the EvalTypeHandler interface
Exec eval bindings in RuntimeConfig YAML run checks in Python, Node.js or any language
rest_eval and a2a_eval delegate to HTTP endpoints or A2A agents, return the service score, and reject min_score/max_score
Custom guardrails implement the ProviderHook interface
Custom LLM judges implement the JudgeProvider interface
The pack YAML key for guardrails is validators:
